# Professor Natassa Pippa – Academic Website

> Assistant Professor of Pharmaceutical Technology at the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens (NKUA), specializing in drug delivery systems, nanomedicine, and pharmaceutical nanotechnology.

This site presents Professor Natassa Pippa’s (Νατάσσα Πίππα) research, publications, teaching, and distinctions. Content is available in English and Greek (Ελληνικά). Use the sections below to locate specific information.

## Key facts

- **Name:** Natassa Pippa (Νατάσσα Πίππα)
- **Role:** Assistant Professor of Pharmaceutical Technology
- **Affiliation:** National and Kapodistrian University of Athens (ΕΚΠΑ / NKUA), Department of Pharmacy, Division of Pharmaceutical Technology
- **Contact:** natpippa@pharm.uoa.gr
- **Location:** University Campus, 15771 Athens, Greece

## Profile and background

- [About](https://natassapippa.gr/#about): Current position, affiliation, contact details, and short research summary

## Research

- [Research interests](https://natassapippa.gr/#research): Drug delivery and advanced drug delivery systems, pharmaceutical technology and nanotechnology, liposomes and nanosystems, protein/peptide delivery, physicochemical and thermodynamic evaluation, quality assurance and regulation
- [Techniques](https://natassapippa.gr/#research): Light scattering, DSC, freeze-drying, spectroscopy, confocal microscopy, SEM, AFM

## Publications and scholarly profiles

- [Selected publications](https://natassapippa.gr/#publications): Research articles and reviews in drug delivery, nanomedicine, and pharmaceutical formulations
- [Books](https://natassapippa.gr/#books): Books and edited volumes on pharmaceutical technology, nanomedicine, and biomedical applications
- [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=en&user=JT7E51cAAAAJ): Full publication list and citations
- [Scopus](https://www.scopus.com/authid/detail.uri?authorId=54974390600): Author profile

## Academic activities

- [Teaching](https://natassapippa.gr/#teaching): Undergraduate and postgraduate courses, e-learning, and lifelong learning at NKUA
- [Awards and honors](https://natassapippa.gr/#awards): L’Oréal-UNESCO For Women in Science, IAAM awards, Lindau Nobel Laureate Meeting, and other distinctions
